item.title: About
item.description: Hello! I am Alessandro. Beginner CTF player. Wannabe security reseracher. Trying to make a satellite go to space @PoliSpace. Projects.log 6s CubeSat 12.2022-present Team Leader for the Software Subsystem (from 09.2023). Design and testing of the Flight Software for the onboard computer (Nanomind A3200). Design of mission’s mode manager. AOCS module integration. CyberChallenge 2022 Participating in CyberChallenge in 2022 allowed me to learn various topics of cybersecurity. I trained in Binary Exploitation, Reverse Engineering, Web Security, and Cryptography through CTF (Capture The Flag) challenges.

item.title: Tmux Setup
item.description: Tmux default configuration didn’t fit well my workflow. This is my tmux configuration: tmux prefix # Set prefix to Ctrl unbind C-b set -g prefix C-a The prefix is a combiantion of key that initiate any tmux command. For this reason it must be confortable to type over and over. The first you learn touch typing (writing without looking at the keyboard) is to always keep you hand on the home row.
